content.title: Impinj (PI): Revenue Forecast to Grow 19.8% Annually, Outpacing US Market Ahead of Earnings
content.summary: Impinj (PI) has narrowed its losses at an impressive pace over the last five years, cutting annual losses by 46.4% per year. Revenue is forecast to grow 19.8% annually, nearly doubling the broader US market’s growth estimate of 10.3%, while earnings are projected to expand by 113.9% a year. This puts the company on track for profitability within three years.
